title: Bolden had no other job; Jones's barbering and blindness
summary: Bolden only played music after school, never barbered. Jones was a barber himself, stopped about 20 years ago and lost his sight.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music
